name: Old Stone Path 2019 Ancient Tree Raw Pu-erh Tea Cake (357g)
marketing_tip: Journey through time with every sip of this 2019 ancient tree harvest, characterized by its robust character and complex depth.
body: Sourced from ancient tea trees along the traditional "Old Stone Path" (Jiu Shi Ma), this 357g raw Pu-erh cake represents the pinnacle of traditional craftsmanship. The 2019 vintage has developed a smooth, mellow profile while retaining the vibrant energy and multi-layered complexity typical of high-altitude ancient groves.
